title: Scientists warn 1.5°C climate change threshold could arrive by 2029
summary: Climate action has stalled for five years as fossil fuel development keeps growing.
llm_summary: Scientists say the planet could hit the critical 1.5 °C warming limit as early as 2029 if current trends continue, highlighting a stark deadline for the tech sector’s sustainability roadmaps. Over the past five years, global climate policies have stalled while fossil‑fuel extraction and consumption have kept rising, undermining emissions
